caption: The drawing consists of a repeating pattern on a brownish background. The design is organized within diamond-shaped sections outlined in white, each junction marked by a small white star-like motif. Inside the diamonds, there are stylized floral elements: some centralized white flowers with red centers and elongated petals, groups of stemmed round fruits or buds shaded in blue and red, and branching leaves. The flowers have a combination of grayish and light blue petals with touches of red and white, with stems and smaller leaves depicted in dark brown or black. Along the top edge, there is a decorative border of interlocking loops and stylized leaves in light blue, red, and white, forming a band across the width of the drawing. The composition is symmetrical and evenly spaced, with the floral and fruit motifs filling the diamonds in a regular sequence.
title: Hand Painted Wall (Detail)
